title: Digital Marketing & Growth Executive
description:
Digital Marketing & Growth Executive

Up to £37,500: Shrewsbury: Maternity Cover: Immediate Start: Office Based

As Digital Marketing & Growth Executive, you're the person who watches an advert and immediately starts thinking about who else it could reach.

A different audience.
Another industry.
A market nobody's really thought about targeting yet.

You don't just understand how Meta advertising works, ou understand why people respond to it, what makes them click and, more importantly, what makes them become a customer.

And you've probably got more ideas than you're currently getting the chance to use.

Sound familiar?

As Digital Marketing & Growth Executive, you'll have the opportunity to do something about that.

You'll be joining a growing business in Shrewsbury that's already generating some brilliant traction through YouTube and Meta.
The content's there, the videos are there and the enquiries are coming in.

But there's so much more they could be doing with it!
Imagine looking at the manufacturing industry and spotting an opportunity in concrete production. Or realising there's a whole market of bakeries that could benefit from what the business offers.

You'll be the person who sees that opportunity, works out how to reach those businesses and gets the right campaigns in front of them.

And when the leads start coming in, you'll make sure they're getting to the people who can turn them into customers.

As Digital Marketing & Growth Executive you need to be someone who's got a bit of sales in them too.

Not someone who wants to spend their days cold calling

Someone who understands the commercial side of marketing, who gets excited about generating genuine business, not just likes and impressions.

You'll already know your way around Meta Ads Manager, advertising funnels, audience targeting and campaign performance, that's important because you'll need to get stuck in from day one.

But it's your personality that'll really make the difference.
You're curious.
You've got energy.
You ask questions.
You spot things other people miss.

Perhaps you're currently a Digital Marketing Executive who knows they're capable of more but hasn't been given the opportunity to prove it.

Well, here's your chance.
As Digital Marketing & Growth Executive, you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas, explore different markets and see what happens when the campaigns you're running actually turn into business.
It's initially a maternity cover contract, and you'll need to be available to start immediately.

But you'll be joining a growing business with plenty happening, where the experience you bring and the ideas you have will genuinely matter.
Up to £37,500, based in Shrewsbury.

So, if you're a Digital Marketing & Growth Executive who gets just as much satisfaction from a new customer enquiry as you do from a brilliantly performing campaign, perhaps it's time we had a conversation.
This role is exclusive to Marshall Harmony, you won't be contacted by any third parties. If you'd like more info or want to talk it through, just drop us a message or send your CV to the email above.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Overview

Our client is an established professional services business in Shrewsbury and they are looking for a Marketing Manager to deliver all marketing activities across the organisation. The role works closely with the Director responsible for marketing supporting the development of the overall marketing plan.

The Marketing Manager is responsible for managing the CRM system, co-ordinating internal communications and departmental marketing plans, organising events as well as maintaining social media and website content.

Duties
- Maintaining accurate and reliable client and prospect data
- Creating and managing marketing campaigns
- Supporting the development and implementation of marketing plans across departments
- Working with department heads to identify marketing opportunities and objectives for their clients
- Reviewing client survey feedback, sharing findings and co-ordinating follow up actions to support awareness and lead generation

Experience
- Experienced in a marketing or communications role
- Experienced in using Marketing Design Tools (eg Adobe Suite, Canva)
- Experienced in using CRM systems
- Experienced in managing social media platforms and website content
- Strong organisation and project co-ordination skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- A marketing qualification or relevant professional certification (desirable)
- Experienced in using email marketing platforms (desirable)
- Knowledge of SEO and website analytics tools (desirable)
- Experienced in co-ordinating corporate events (desirable)
- A full driving licence and own vehicle is essential
